detail: The budget commits $250,000 of campus cost share ($62,500 a year). NSF 25-523: "Committed cost sharing is not allowed for the new E-CORE awards".
F&A is charged on $560,000 of sensor-network base stations and towers. Equipment is excluded from the MTDC base.
The Northern Plains Agricultural Commission letter is a letter of support. E-CORE: "Letters of support are not allowed"; only up to ten letters of collaboration may be included.
The budget funds subawards to all four campuses, but only Harlow Bend and Grier Falls have a current letter of commitment; Pellamy and Ondrak have none.
